title: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in Stationary and Nonstationary Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2607.24673v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We describe Causal-TS, an open-source Python library that provides a common interface and lagged-graph representation for causal discovery (structure learning) from stationary and nonstationary multivariate time series. It learns lagged and contemporaneous causal graphs with constraint-based (CDNOTS, CDNOTS+, Cedar), score-based (LGES, TGES, GES, LASSO-VAR, VARLiNGAM, Granger) and hybrid (GRACE, REAP) methods. The constraint-based methods share 17 linear and nonlinear conditional independence (CI) tests, nine with PyTorch implementations. It also provides candidate-regime detection with per-regime discovery, latent-confounder correction (LUCID), missing- and mixed-data support, a data-driven configuration recommender, a command-line interface, and an optional DoWhy bridge from a discovered graph to causal effect estimates and counterfactuals. The library is pip-installable, tested on Python 3.10-3.14, and available at https://github.

translated_title: Causal-TS：一个用于平稳与非平稳时间序列因果发现的Python库
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了Causal-TS，这是一个开源Python库，为平稳和非平稳多变量时间序列的因果发现（结构学习）提供了统一接口和滞后图表示。它能够通过基于约束的方法（CDNOTS、CDNOTS+、Cedar）、基于评分的方法（LGES、TGES、GES、LASSO-VAR、VARLiNGAM、Granger）以及混合方法（GRACE、REAP）学习滞后和同期因果图。基于约束的方法共享17种线性和非线性条件独立性（CI）检验，其中九种提供了PyTorch实现。该库还提供候选状态检测与逐状态因果发现、潜在混杂因子校正（LUCID）、缺失数据和混合数据支持、数据驱动的配置推荐器、命令行界面，以及可选的DoWhy桥接功能，可从发现的因果图进行因果效应估计和反事实分析。该库可通过pip安装，已在Python 3.10-3.14上完成测试，并在GitHub上开放获取。
tldr: Causal-TS是一个开源Python库，为平稳与非平稳时间序列的因果发现提供统一接口，集成了多种约束、评分和混合方法，并支持状态检测、混杂因子校正以及因果效应估计。
en_tdlr: Causal-TS is an open-source Python library providing a unified interface for causal discovery in stationary and nonstationary time series, integrating constraint-based, score-based, and hybrid methods with regime detection, latent-confounder correction, and causal effect estimation.
